source_train: unaltered P3 factual AdamW native learner, 40 old + 40 reversed public analytic events
source_checkpoints: immutable root/40/80 C2 validated cold restores

experiments.fast_swap: restore only saved step40 native.fast_weights into frozen step80 full native state without replacing step80 recurrent/history
experiments.full_swap: restore saved step40 recurrent/fast/history into frozen step80 model, no gradient or new factual outcome
experiments.sham: roll old fast_weight width by exactly one scalar; preserve same shape, L2 norm and total stored scalars
experiments.model_swap: step40 model with the frozen step80 saved native state
experiments.oracle_selection: Evaluator chooses known saved state for probing. No legitimate learned or inferred context routing is present.
experiments.identical_inputs: 16 old and 16 new alternating actions, sensor zero, dt 0.2, same as C4 read-only test
experiments.evaluation: each sample begins from the same immutable chosen native state, model step produces prediction only; observed outcome is for score calculation after prediction, not fed back

proof_limits: An evaluator-selected archived state is an oracle probe and NOT learned context routing.
Old and new factual regimes have incompatible targets for identical instantaneous inputs.
Fast and native state from old checkpoint may be mismatched with learned current model parameters; negative outcomes are valuable.
No new facts are ingested and there is NO fast-weight or optimizer update in the evaluation arms.
Offline static snapshot reuse is not an accepted persistent memory hierarchy, physical backup or autonomous cognition.
Public reused DEV task, no held-out scientific success, conventional-control parity or unseen-world transfer.
